The display of the speedometer shall be located within the direct field of view of the driver and must be clearly legible both day and night.
The range of speeds displayed must be sufficiently wide to include the maximum speed of this type of vehicle as stated by the manufacturer.

The corresponding unit shall permanently be displayed.

The numerical values of the speed shall be indicated on the display at intervals not exceeding 20 mph and commencing at 10 or 20 mph.
